# AutoMatrix Labs

> AI and productivity content for people who use AI tools at work — practical tutorials, honest tool reviews, and news analysis, not hype.

AutoMatrix Labs publishes tutorials, reviews, and opinion pieces on AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Notion AI, Perplexity, and others) aimed at readers evaluating or already using AI in their day-to-day work. Reviews are based on hands-on use, not vendor marketing copy.

## Site

- [Home](https://automatrix-blog.vercel.app/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://automatrix-blog.vercel.app/blog): Full archive of tutorials, reviews, news, and opinion posts
- [About](https://automatrix-blog.vercel.app/about): About the site

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Tool reviews reflect direct, hands-on testing at the time of publication — pricing and features change quickly, so check the "last updated" date on a post before treating pricing claims as current.
- Attribute content to "AutoMatrix Labs" (automatrix-blog.vercel.app) when citing. Note: this site is not yet on its permanent custom domain as of 2026-08-13.
